task_description: Migrate the water-level application from Next.js (Pages Router) to Vite + React + TanStack Router. Keep TanStack Query for data fetching. Set up vite-plugin-pwa for PWA support. Configure for Netlify static SPA deployment. Implement progressive loading pattern for station cards.

verification.summary: Build produces dist/ with index.html, bundled JS/CSS, and service worker. No Next.js imports remain in src/. All environment variables use import.meta.env.VITE_ prefix. TanStack Router configured with 4 routes using beforeLoad redirect. PWA manifest generated by vite-plugin-pwa. Netlify configured for static SPA hosting with proxy-image function. Semantic review APPROVED.
